text: Figure 15.1: Crypto Stack - Reference Architecture In order to realize this layered security architecture, the Crypto Stack API does not only perform typical crypto operations like encryption and decryption but also provides native support for: 1. Operating with encrypted keys or key handles 2. Managing keys securely despite possible application compromise 3. Constraining application access to and allowed operations on keys
